 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LaMelo Ball and the Minnesota Timberwolves host Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers on Monday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 Portland is coming off a 120-107 win over the Sacramento Kings on Friday, entering the matchup with a 9-3 record sitting atop the Northwest Division of the Western Conference. Forward Avdija leads the team in scoring at 23.9 points per game and in assists at 6.3, while center Donovan Clingan leads the team in rebounding at 10.5.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Trail Blazers vs Timberwolves TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Portland Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant (1)Kelley L Cox-Imagn Images
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 Venue: Target Center, Minneapolis
 TV: DirecTV, NBA League Pass, KUNP 16, DAZN MIN, BlazerVision
 Live stream: NBA League Pass through Amazon Prime Video.
 Fans can watch the game for free through various avenues. One option is Amazon Prime, where users can sign up for a seven-day free trial of NBA League Pass. Another option is DraftKings Sportsbook, which offers a three-month free trial. Users must submit a minimum deposit of $5. Another way for fans to watch for free is through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free trial that can be canceled before five days.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Minnesota lost its most recent game against the Chicago Bulls on Saturday, 117-106, sitting in second place behind Portland in the Northwest Division of the Western Conference. Guard Ball leads the team in scoring at 18.6 points per game and assists at 6.2, while center Rudy Gobert leads the team in rebounds at 11.4.
 For Portland, guard Chris Youngblood (foot), guard Vit Krejci (ankle), guard Ja Morant (hamstring) and guard Shaedon Sharpe (knee) are all out for the game. For Minnesota, guard Jaylen Clark (hamstring), guard Anthony Edwards (knee) and guard Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles) are all out for the game.
